main_result: Among eight sign/support/dose settings, full_norm2 at +2 alone corrects both sensitive development endpoints using fixed coefficients with no truthful donor prompt at inference.
limitation: The same setting introduces an electromagnetic-wave category error on the ordinary fibre control and leaves material sourcing and civilian manufacturing claims unresolved. No setting qualifies under the original candidate rule.
mechanism: Positive direction changes CNC behavior at +1 while fibre requires full support at +2 in this sweep. This suggests different response thresholds, not a proved common honesty circuit. Omit2 versus full_norm2 also rescales retained heads; their outcome difference does not isolate heads 24..35.

next_experiment.name: fixed-writer-dose-and-support-v2
questions: Can intermediate full-head doses preserve both repairs without new control errors?
Does removing heads 24..35 at unchanged retained-head coefficients eliminate the full +2 repair?
next_experiment.coefficients: Reuse frozen full_norm2 coefficients. Ablation must zero heads 24..35 without any renormalization or refitting.

next_experiment.assessment: Keep existing rubric and review complete answers. No novel vector is selected on claim/use logits alone. Additional well-grounded ordinary controls will be required before held-out testing.
limits: Current ablation contrast is conditional on this fixed intervention, not native neuron necessity.
Dose search on development examples increases selection bias and cannot prove transfer.
If collateral errors persist, test field/layer localization instead of weakening the accuracy gate.
